query:
mutation RequestReport($reportType: Int!, $viewId: BigInt, $zones: [String!], $locale: String) {
  requestReport(
    reportType: $reportType
    viewId: $viewId
    zones: $zones
    locale: $locale
  ) {
    reportID
    requestTimestamp
    generationTimestamp
    requestor
    reportType
    pdf
    status
    lang
    __typename
  }
}
